title: Set Input and Invoke Variable
code:
Page.Variables.getDepartmentDetails.setInput({ id: empId });
Page.Variables.getDepartmentDetails.invoke();
explanation: Sets input parameters using `setInput()` and invokes the variable to fetch data or perform an operation.

title: Invoke Variable with Callbacks
explanation: This invokes the variable and provides **inline success and error callbacks** specific to this call. These callbacks are executed **only for this invocation.** ⚠️ **Note:** This does NOT register a permanent handler like `onSuccess`. Instead, it handles success/error for this single `.invoke()` operation.

title: Dynamic Variable Invocation with Data
syntax:
var sv = [Scope].Variables.[variableName];
sv.invoke({ inputFields }, successCallback, errorCallback);
explanation: Demonstrates assigning a variable reference to a local variable and invoking it with input fields and callbacks.

title: Get Data from a Variable
code:
var result = Page.Variables.[variable_name].getData();
console.log("result:", result);
explanation: Retrieves the data stored in a variable after it has been invoked. Useful for accessing the result later in logic.

title: Clear Data from a Variable
code:
var result = Page.Variables.[variable_name].clearData();
console.log("result:", result);
explanation: Clears the existing data from the variable. Useful when you want to reset the variable before a new invocation.

title: Set Input Fields Individually Before Invocation
synonyms: set variable input one by one
explanation: Shows how to set input fields one at a time using `setInput(key, value)` before invoking the variable.

title: Set Input Using Object Before Invocation
explanation: Demonstrates setting multiple input fields at once by passing an object to `setInput`, then invoking the variable.

title: Handle Variable Success Event
explanation: Registers a **permanent event handler** for the variable's success event. This handler is executed automatically every time the variable completes successfully. ⚠️ **Note:** This is NOT the same as passing a success callback in the `.invoke()` method—it is a **persistent handler**, attached once and remains active for the variable's lifecycle.

title: Modify Dataset Before UI Binding
explanation: Runs before dataset is bound to the UI. Modifies each record by adding a computed URL using an App function.

title: Process Result from Variable
explanation: Runs regardless of success/failure. Filters only active entries and saves them to another variable.

title: Handle Error in Variable
explanation: Logs the error and flags 'hasError' variable to true on failure of 'jsCreateEmployee'.

title: Before Variable Update Hook
explanation: Adds 'lastModified' and 'updatedBy' metadata before update call executes.

title: Validate Input Before Variable Update
explanation: Prevents update call when 'appName' is missing in input. Logs a warning and returns false.

title: Navigate to Page Without Parameters
code: Page.Actions.goToPage_TestPage.invoke();
explanation: Triggers navigation to 'TestPage' without passing any parameters.

title: Navigate to Page with Parameters
synonyms: go to page and pass values
code: Page.Actions.goToPage_EmployeeDetailsPage.invoke({ data: { 'paramDept': '1', 'paramEmpdId': '2' } });
explanation: Navigates to 'EmployeeDetailsPage' and passes values 'paramDept=1' and 'paramEmpId=2' as route parameters.

title: Set Data and Navigate to Page
explanation: Uses `setData` to pass values before invoking navigation to 'TestPage'.

title: Trigger Basic Notification
code: Page.Actions.notificationAction1.invoke();
explanation: Triggers the default notification action named 'notificationAction1'.

title: Toast Notification with Message and Style
code: Partial.Actions.notificationAction1.invoke({ message: 'My custom message', position: 'bottom right', class: 'info' });
explanation: Displays a custom toast notification at bottom-right with the info styling.

title: Notification with Data Payload
code: Page.Actions.notificationAction1.invoke({ data: { mode: 'edit' } });
explanation: Triggers a notification and sends data object `{mode: 'edit'}` which can be accessed in event handlers.

title: Handle Notification OK Event
explanation: Handles the `onOk` event for the notification and logs the data received from the notification trigger.

title: Define Custom Page Method
explanation: Creates a page method that validates two inputs. If missing, it shows an error toast. Otherwise, it sets input and calls a variable.
